title: Rav Nachman bar Natan
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Batra 8b. In the Rosh’s reading there (siman 30), Nachman bar Natan said, “Scripture says, ‘They shall take the gold.’” Our text has simply Rav Nachman.

notes.text: The Rosh marker כ״ל differs from the historical OCR form ם״ל and remains unresolved. Hyman contrasts the Rosh’s full patronymic with bare Rav Nachman in his text.

The saved whole Vilna Rosh chapter1 scalar at index29 (the thirtieth segment) has א״ר נחמן בר נתן and the gold quotation; the saved Davidson Bava Batra8b paragraph has full Rav Nachman without the patronymic. This supports Hyman’s reported contrast and a corresponding1:30 location, not a literal expansion of כ״ל or OCR ם״ל. Hyman’s heading supplies full Rav; the Rosh itself abbreviates the title. The biblical verse has not been newly inspected.

Hyman’s print (vol. III, p. 945) reads ס״ל, where the supplied Hebrew has כ״ל and the earlier OCR has ם״ל. The Vilna Rosh, Bava Batra 1:30, names Nachman bar Natan with an abbreviated title. The consulted text of Bava Batra 8b has Rav Nachman without the patronymic. Both quote Exodus 28:5.
